name: Greek & Latin Roots
description: 152 Latin & Greek root cards with 597 derivatives, in a low-fatigue cool grey-green reading design. Front shows the root alone; tap or flip to reveal meaning, derivatives (tagged TOP500 / TOP2k / SUPP) and an etymology note. Origin-tinted accent (Greek vs Latin), pronounce / flip / mark / favorite, three skins. Interface is English-only.
